newsitem.title: USA: Educational sets first div of $0.01/shr.
newsitem.headline: Educational sets first div of $0.01/shr.

text.p: Educational Development Corp said Monday it will for the first time pay a dividend of $0.01 a share on August 14 to shareholders of record on August 1.

The children's books seller said it intended to pay a small but growing annual dividend, which should not exceed 20 percent of its annual cash flow. It added it will use the balance of the cash flow to pay for future growth.
The company's stock traded at 6-1/8 Monday, up 3/8.
